mapper.sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.source_type, o.alert_id, o.dept_id, d.dept_name, o.place_type, o.hazard_id, h.hazard_name, o.equip_id, p.post_name AS equip_name, o.hazard_title, o.hazard_category, o.risk_level, o.legal_basis, o.rectify_measure, o.responsible_user_id, o.responsible_name, o.deadline, o.rectify_image_url, o.rectify_note, o.ai_recheck_passed, o.ai_recheck_comment, o.status, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_time FROM ehs_hazard_order o LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON o.dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN ehs_hazard_profile h ON o.hazard_id = h.hazard_id LEFT JOIN sys_post p ON o.equip_id = p.post_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ehs_hazard_order ( order_no, source_type, alert_id, dept_id, place_type, hazard_id, equip_id, hazard_title, hazard_category, risk_level, legal_basis, rectify_measure, responsible_user_id, responsible_name, deadline, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, COALESCE(#{sourceType}, 'MANUAL'), #{alertId}, COALESCE(#{deptId}, 103), COALESCE(#{placeType}, 'production'), #{hazardId}, #{equipId}, #{hazardTitle}, COALESCE(#{hazardCategory}, '现场安全隐患'), COALESCE(#{riskLevel}, '较大隐患'), #{legalBasis}, #{rectifyMeasure}, COALESCE(#{responsibleUserId}, 2), COALESCE(#{responsibleName}, '注册安全员'), COALESCE(#{deadline}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '3 days'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'OPEN'), COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'admin'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
